products.name: Tea Tree Purifying Tonic
products.description:
Meet your scalp's quick-relief spray: a lightweight tonic designed for oily scalp that tends to feel itchy, warm, or uncomfortable by midday.
Tea tree essential oil and tea tree leaf extract work to help control excess oil, so your scalp stays feeling fresh rather than weighed down — even with frequent use throughout the day.
Peppermint and menthol deliver an instant cooling sensation, helping calm a scalp that's overheated from stress or a long day.
The airy, lightweight mist absorbs quickly without any stickiness or residue, and a silicone-free formula keeps things gentle — since scalp pores are larger and more sensitive than facial pores.
Best for: oily, easily irritated scalp.
Use: any time your scalp feels warm, itchy, or uncomfortable — reapply as needed throughout the day.
keyBenefits: A cooling scalp tonic for oily, uncomfortable scalp — instant relief without the buildup.
products.howToUse:
Step 1. Shake well before use.
Step 2. Hold the nozzle close to your scalp and spray evenly across the entire scalp or specific areas of concern.
Step 3. Using your fingertips, massage in gentle upward strokes from the nape of your neck toward the crown to help the tonic absorb smoothly.
Tip: Works especially well when your scalp feels warm — such as after a workout, in humid weather, or during a stressful day. A wooden scalp massage brush can help work the tonic in even further.

products.name: Ritual Hair Oil Lavender & Patchouli
products.description:
Meet the hair oil that proves silicone-free can still mean silky: a lightweight, plant-oil-based formula designed for dry to damaged hair.
Prakaxi seed and babassu oils help protect hair from heat and styling tools, while moringa, argan kernel, and jojoba oils deliver nourishment and moisture to the hair's surface for less breakage.
Sweet almond, coconut, and rosehip oils add shine and bounce, helping hair resist snapping during brushing and stay strong from the core out.
Lavender and patchouli lead a blend of essential oils in a herbaceous, grounding scent, layered with rosewood, ylang ylang, bergamot, and sweet orange for a warm, calming finish.
Best for: all hair types, especially dry to damaged hair.
Use: after shampooing, or any time hair needs an extra dose of shine.
keyBenefits: A silicone-free hair oil that delivers shine and moisture to dry, damaged hair — without the greasy weight.
products.howToUse:
Step 1. After shampooing, lightly towel-dry your hair to remove excess water.
Step 2. Take an appropriate amount into your palms and rub together, then smooth over your hair.
Step 3. Apply an extra layer to dry ends or particularly damaged areas as needed.
Tip: The oil is lightweight, so pump close to your palm to avoid over-dispensing. Rub the oil between your palms first rather than applying directly to hair, to help avoid clumping. Since it's silicone-free, using too much at once can make hair feel weighed down — 1-2 pumps for shoulder-length or shorter hair, 2-4 pumps for longer hair. Applying before bed lets the plant-oil formula work overnight, and it's gentle enough not to worry about it transferring onto your pillow or face.

products.name: Freestyle Texturizer
products.description:
A versatile styling cream that creates effortless texture, flexible hold, and natural movement without buildup. Lightweight cassava absorbs excess oil while boosting volume, natural sugar cane adds definition and bounce, and palo santo helps support a balanced, healthy scalp. Hair is left full of piece-y texture, touchable body, and lived-in definition that lasts throughout the day.
Best for: Fine to Medium
keyBenefits: Sizes 3.3 oz and under are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged.
products.howToUse: Apply to damp or dry hair depending on desired effect. For maximum volume, focus application at the roots; for defined texture, concentrate on the ends; or apply throughout for overall body. To create piece-y definition, flip hair to one side and work product into roots and underside, then flip back and twist small sections at the ends. Can be layered for increased texture and hold.

products.name: Tea Tree Purifying Shampoo
products.description:
Meet your daily reset for oily, easily-weighed-down scalp: a tea tree shampoo formulated to help clear excess oil at the source.
Tea tree essential oil and tea tree leaf extract work to help manage overactive sebum, keeping your scalp feeling fresh rather than greasy by the end of the day.
Peppermint and mint help deliver a quick cooling sensation to an overheated scalp, easing that heavy, stuffy discomfort that oily scalp can bring.
Probiotics and caffeine help rebalance scalp that's lost its footing, while biotin and dexpanthenol add targeted nourishment to help support healthier-feeling roots.
Best for: oily, easily irritated scalp.
Use: daily, in place of your regular shampoo.
keyBenefits: Wash away the day's oil, keep the freshness.
A tea tree shampoo designed to help control excess oil and keep an oily scalp feeling clean and comfortable, all day long.
products.howToUse:
Step 1. Take an appropriate amount, work into a lather, and massage evenly across wet scalp and hair.
Step 2. Rinse thoroughly with water.
Tip: Before shampooing, brushing your scalp backward against the direction of hair growth with a wooden scalp brush can help with a first pass of cleansing and open up space between strands for a deeper wash. A silicone-tip scalp brush can also help gently lift away pore buildup that fingers can't reach, while supporting scalp circulation.
